lines.text: From Scientology to SoulCycle, Amanda Montell takes you on a trip through different cults and cult-like organizations, and analyzes the way that language influences their members. For the linguist, the pop-culture fanatic, and the murder podcast fan alike, Cultish is a fun read to add to your shelf.
